- Net amount per VAT group is 2.566,06 EUR and VAT 256,61 EUR; sum = 2.822,67 EUR which matches Endbetrag. Consistent.

- Preserve decimals as in document (two decimals). Remove percentage symbol for Vat.Rate and return numbers. If any field missing, would be empty; here all fields present.
